remarks: Homesites are now available on Autumn Meadows Lane, the next phase in Miller's Crossing! Upon entering through the front door, you will encounter the captivating foyer of the Maris floorplan. A den/study area is directly off the foyer. Proceeding towards the back of the house, you will come across the dining room, while directly across the hallway is a half bathroom. The dining room provides convenient access to the luxurious kitchen and dinette space, as well as the generously-sized great room, creating a beautiful open space for entertaining and interaction. Adjacent to the great room is a flex room that can be utilized for any desired purpose. Additionally, the mudroom, which includes a closet and laundry room, is located off the great room, leading to the garage. Upon reaching the second floor, you can take advantage of the balcony, which provides a view of the open foyer and spacious great room below. The primary bedroom features a huge bathroom and a sizable walk-in closet. The two remaining bedrooms, each equipped with ample closet space are also located on the second level. Positioned between these two bedrooms is a large full bathroom. This floor includes an unfinished bonus area, offering the potential of additional space and many options. This home is To Be Built. Build your dream home today!
